failure_catalog.error: ImportError: cannot import name 'GATE_RECORD' from 'conftest' (.../tests/optimization_v8/region/conftest.py) at test_installed_wheel_gates.py:154
failure_catalog.error_class: import-order / module-name shadowing (NOT timeout, NOT thread-cap, NOT fork, NOT numba threading-layer)
failure_catalog.mechanism: pytest (prepend import mode, no __init__.py in the v8 test dirs) imports every suite's conftest.py under the bare module name 'conftest'; the last-collected conftest (alphabetically region/) owns that name at test RUN time. The installed suite imports helpers via 'from conftest import ...' at module level in 3 test files AND inside test functions (line 154). Module-level imports happened while installed's own conftest still owned the name (installed collects 3rd); the in-function import executes after region's conftest rebound it -> ImportError.
failure_catalog.causality: pre-existing defect in the installed suite's import style; triggered by ANY later-collected sibling conftest. Reproduced identically with N8-22 dirs ignored (runB). N8-22 caused 0 failures.
failure_catalog.suggested_fix_pattern_not_applied: per N8-22 convention (tests/optimization_v8/policy/policy_test_helpers.py + memory note v8-test-conftest-name-collision): move shared helpers into a uniquely named module next to the suite and import that instead of 'conftest'. Owned by the installed/N8-23 worker; not modified here per classification-first instruction.
